In the FutuRaM project, material flow analysis was conducted for waste electric an electronic equipment, waste batteries, end-of-life vehicles, construction and demolition waste from buildings and wind turbines, and slags and ashes including stock and flow models (from POM to waste generated or collected) and recovery models (from waste generated or collected to secondary raw materials).
